title: VTC Groups — Members — Add — payload
description: A group manager adds a community member to a static group; where the group issues credentials, the group's DID issues the member a membership credential first. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

reason.description: Why, recorded with the change and shown to anyone who must approve it.

Response.title: VTC Groups — Members — Add — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/groups/members/add/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/groups/members/add/0.1#response.

credentialId.description: The membership credential offered to the member, or null when the group issues none or the addition is pending.
